title: THE CLOCK IN THE ALERT LANE, WITH A SHORT HINT
why: His order of 2026-10-09: every raid line reads like a shooter HUD. THIRTY SECONDS and TEN SECONDS were one row of about seventy characters, the mark and then a sentence about the way out, that the next remark pushed down. They are now alerts with a clock glyph: THIRTY SECONDS as a warning and TEN SECONDS as a critical line, each with one short hint under it (at most 48 characters). The hint no longer says way out, is down or lands, and it names the use key through the key labels, so on a controller it says [X]. The minute marks read 3 MINUTES LEFT as objective rows. When the marks fire and their sounds are unchanged.
now: THIRTY SECONDS and TEN SECONDS are alerts with one short hint that names your use key.
